svg.title: NOT IN never matches NULL -- accepted_values alone lets a NULL borough through
svg.desc: stg_cityflow__zones has one real row, zone_id 265, Outside of NYC, with a NULL borough -- not an empty string, a genuine SQL NULL, confirmed with IS NULL. accepted_values compiles to a WHERE clause checking value_field NOT IN a list of seven boroughs. In SQL's own three-valued logic, NULL NOT IN (...) evaluates to NULL, neither true nor false, so the WHERE clause never selects that row -- accepted_values reports PASS with the NULL borough still sitting there unflagged. Adding a separate not_null test on the same column catches it directly: FAIL 1 (or WARN 1 with severity configured), Got 1 result. The fix is not a different accepted_values list -- it is pairing accepted_values with not_null, since the two tests check genuinely different things and neither substitutes for the other.
svg.text: Why accepted_values Alone Missed a Real Row
zone_id 265, "Outside of NYC" -- borough is NULL, confirmed with IS NULL, not an empty string
select value_field from all_values where value_field not in ('Manhattan', 'Brooklyn', ...)
NULL not in (...) evaluates to NULL in SQL's own three-valued logic -- not TRUE, so the row is never selected
the NULL row is never checked
against the values list at all
The fix isn't a different values list
accepted_values and not_null check genuinely different things --
pair them whenever a column's own completeness actually matters.
